I have farmed maize in Mbeya for many years, and I know that even on a small plot like this, putting some fertilizer makes a big difference in the harvest. I will buy one bag of DAP from the agro-dealer and plant improved seed because the rains here are good and I want to get the most from this land. My wife and children will do most of the planting and weeding, but I will hire a few day laborers to help with the heavy clearing at the start of the season. I do not need to irrigate because our rains are reliable, and I will not waste money on chemicals for insects since maize here does not suffer too badly from pests.
